# Crab Dev Expert

Expert assistant for the `@crab-dev` monorepo — covers UI component development, design token architecture, Yarn 4 PnP, Webpack/Rollup build tooling, and Turbo orchestration.

## When to Use

- Creating a new `rc-*` component from scratch
- Designing or modifying `token.toml` design tokens (3-tier system)
- Troubleshooting Yarn PnP module resolution failures
- Fixing Turbo circular dependency warnings in the task graph
- Configuring packify/crustify/lignify build pipelines
- Writing Jest 30 + React Testing Library tests in ESM mode
- Debugging CI workflow failures (Node 24, PnP, Turbo caching)

## Component Creation Procedure

### 1. Scaffold the component

Create the directory under `components/rc-{name}/` with this structure:

```
components/rc-{name}/
├── package.json            # See template below
├── tsconfig.json           # extends @crab-dev/standards-typescript-preset/tsconfig.browser.react.json
├── eslint.config.js        # import { Browser } from "@crab-dev/standards-eslint-preset"; export default [...Browser.react];
├── jest.config.mjs         # import { browser } from "@crab-dev/standards-jest-preset"; export default browser;
├── token.toml              # Optional: design tokens
├── src/
│   ├── {name}.tsx          # Main component
│   ├── types.ts            # Props interface (optional, can inline)
│   ├── token.ts            # Auto-generated from token.toml — NEVER hand-edit
│   ├── index.ts            # Default export + named type exports
│   └── __tests__/
│       └── {name}.test.tsx
├── docs/
│   ├── *.demo.tsx          # Live demos (auto-scanned by lignify)
│   ├── *.view.tsx          # Page entries
│   └── *.mdx               # Documentation
└── public/
    └── docgen.json         # Auto-generated by react-docgen
```

### 2. package.json template

> **Important:** Before creating `package.json`, read an existing component (e.g. `components/rc-button/package.json`) to copy the **current version numbers** for all devDependencies. The versions below are placeholders — always sync from a sibling component.

```json
{
    "name": "@crab-dev/rc-{name}",
    "version": "0.0.1",
    "type": "module",
    "packageManager": "yarn@4.13.0",
    "scripts": {
        "start": "yarn generate:docgen && yarn generate:token && lignify run-task app:dev",
        "build:library": "packify build",
        "test": "yarn node --experimental-vm-modules $(yarn bin jest)",
        "generate:docgen": "mkdir -p public && react-docgen ./src/{name}.tsx --out ./public/docgen.json",
        "generate:token": "packify generate:css-token",
        "eslint": "eslint"
    },
    "files": ["esm", "cjs", "declarations"],
    "types": "declarations/index.d.ts",
    "main": "cjs/index.cjs",
    "module": "esm/index.mjs",
    "devDependencies": {
        "@crab-dev/lignify": "workspace:^",
        "@crab-dev/packify": "workspace:^",
        "@crab-dev/standards-eslint-preset": "workspace:^",
        "@crab-dev/standards-jest-preset": "workspace:^",
        "@crab-dev/standards-typescript-preset": "workspace:^",
        "@jest/globals": "<COPY_FROM_SIBLING>",
        "@linaria/core": "<COPY_FROM_SIBLING>",
        "@testing-library/dom": "<COPY_FROM_SIBLING>",
        "@testing-library/react": "<COPY_FROM_SIBLING>",
        "@types/react": "<COPY_FROM_SIBLING>",
        "@types/react-dom": "<COPY_FROM_SIBLING>",
        "eslint": "<COPY_FROM_SIBLING>",
        "jest": "<COPY_FROM_SIBLING>",
        "jest-environment-jsdom": "<COPY_FROM_SIBLING>",
        "react": "<COPY_FROM_SIBLING>",
        "react-dom": "<COPY_FROM_SIBLING>",
        "typescript": "<COPY_FROM_SIBLING>"
    },
    "engines": { "node": ">=22" }
}
```

Key rules:
- React 19 is a devDependency (implicit peer, not in peerDependencies)
- Internal deps use `workspace:^`
- `@crab-dev/lignify` and `@crab-dev/packify` in devDependencies
- External runtime deps go in `dependencies`

### 3. Props pattern

```typescript
// Inherit native HTML attributes with Omit for overrides
interface BaseProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, 'onChange'> {
    onChange?: (value: string) => void;
}

// Discriminated union for accessibility
type Props = BaseProps &
    ({ children: ReactNode; 'aria-label'?: string } |
     { children?: never; 'aria-label': string });
```

- Use generic function signatures (not `FC<>`): `function List<T>(props: ListProps<T>) { ... }`

### 4. Styling with Linaria

```typescript
import { css, cx } from '@linaria/core';
import token from './token.js';

const baseStyle = css`
    display: inline-flex;
    transition: ${token.transition};
    background-color: ${token.primary.background.color};
`;
```

- Zero-runtime: compiles to static CSS class names at build time
- Use `cx()` to compose: `className={cx(baseStyle, sizeStyle, props.className)}`
- Token values resolve to `var(--prefix-key, fallback)`

### 5. index.ts export pattern

```typescript
import Component from './{name}.js';
export type { ComponentProps } from './types.js';
export default Component;
```

- Relative imports MUST have `.js` extension
- npm packages do NOT have extensions

### 6. Tests

```typescript
import { describe, it, expect, afterEach } from '@jest/globals';
import { render, cleanup } from '@testing-library/react';
import Component from '../{name}.js';

(globalThis as any).IS_REACT_ACT_ENVIRONMENT = true;

afterEach(() => cleanup());

describe('Component', () => {
    it('renders correctly', () => {
        const { container } = render(<Component />);
        expect(container.firstChild).toBeTruthy();
    });
});
```

## Design Token Procedure

### Three-tier architecture

```
Layer 1: rc-token-global    — Raw primitives (colors in OKLCh, spacing, radius, typography)
Layer 2: rc-token-semantic  — Semantic mappings ($ref → global tokens)
Layer 3: rc-{component}     — Component-specific tokens ($ref → semantic tokens)
```

### token.toml format

```toml
[build]
output = "./src/token.ts"
prefix = "{component-name}"
imports = ["@crab-dev/rc-token-semantic"]

[token]
transition = "transform 100ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)"
size.large.height = "40px"
primary.color = "$ref(color.text.on-brand)"
primary.background.color = "$ref(color.brand.primary)"
```

- `$ref()` resolves to imported token's CSS variable with fallback chain
- Colors use OKLCh: `oklch(lightness chroma hue)`
- Run `yarn generate:token` to regenerate `token.ts` — NEVER hand-edit
- Dark theme: override semantic-layer CSS variables

## Yarn 4 PnP Troubleshooting

### Common issues and fixes

| Problem | Solution |
|---------|----------|
| ESM module can't load from zip | Add to root `package.json` → `dependenciesMeta.{pkg}.unplugged: true` |
| `Qualified path resolution failed` | Package build output missing — build the package first |
| `Cannot find module` for workspace pkg | Check `workspace:^` in dependencies, run `yarn install` |
| `.pnp.cjs` conflicts after merge | `yarn install` to regenerate, commit `.pnp.cjs` |

### Key facts
- No `node_modules` — deps in `.yarn/cache/` zip archives
- `.pnp.cjs` and `.pnp.loader.mjs` must be committed
- CI: `yarn install --immutable` to enforce lockfile consistency
- Some ESM packages fail from zip — use `dependenciesMeta` + `unplugged: true`

## Turbo Build Orchestration

### Circular dependency resolution

Turbo treats ALL workspace dependencies (including devDependencies) as edges in the package graph. When `dependsOn: ["^build:library"]` causes cycles:

1. Identify the cycle from Turbo warning: `A, B, C`
2. Check if the cycle is through devDependencies only
3. Add task-level override in `turbo.json`:

```json
{
    "@crab-dev/rc-menu#build:library": {
        "dependsOn": ["@crab-dev/packify#build:library"],
        "inputs": ["$TURBO_DEFAULT$"],
        "outputs": ["esm/**", "cjs/**", "declarations/**", "css/**"]
    }
}
```

### Cycle prevention

Cycles were resolved by removing unnecessary devDependencies:
- **lignify**: rc-component-preview/rc-menu removed from devDeps and peerDeps (kept as runtime imports in template/)
- **rc-token-global/rc-token-semantic**: lignify, rc-component-preview, rc-menu removed from devDeps (not imported in src/)
- **rc-component-preview**: rc-menu removed from devDeps (not imported in src/)

> **Note:** If new components add devDependencies that create cycles, remove them if they are not imported in `src/`. Use `turbo run build:library --dry-run` to verify.

### Build order
- **packify** must build first (other packages use its CLI)
- Root script: `yarn workspace @crab-dev/packify build:library && turbo run build:library`
- Default `build:library.dependsOn: ["^build:library"]` handles the rest
- Override packages use `dependsOn: ["@crab-dev/packify#build:library"]`

### Turbo cache configuration (turbo.json)
- `build:library` inputs exclude tests, docs, coverage, config files
- `build:library` outputs: `esm/**`, `cjs/**`, `declarations/**`, `css/**`
- `generate:token` inputs: only `token.toml`, output: `src/token.ts`
